[VISUAL RESEARCH]{.eyebrow}

This section is prepared for comparative charts, relationship diagrams, geographic views and interactive research graphics. Every future visualization should identify its source, scope, version, methods and limitations.

::: {.editorial-empty-state}
## A space for future visual evidence

No empirical visualizations are available. Charts and diagrams will be introduced only with reviewed source material and explanatory context.
:::

::: {.area-grid}
::: {.area-item}
### Compare

Charts with clear units, denominators and uncertainty, accompanied by a readable table where possible.
:::
::: {.area-item}
### Connect

Relationship views that explain the meaning and direction of connections, without treating missing evidence as absence.
:::
::: {.area-item}
### Locate

Geographic views with a defined spatial scope, accessible labels and a text alternative.
:::
:::

Accessible descriptions and a static alternative will accompany interactive work. Visual presentation will not substitute for the underlying methodology.
